questions.question: 1. Which probability distribution is used in the negative binomial model to describe the spatial distribution of hosts?
2. The clumping factor (k) in the negative binomial model primarily describes the following:

answers.a: The carrying capacity of the habitat
answers.c: The spatial aggregation (dispersion pattern) of the host population

questions.question: 3. Why are parasitoids considered effective biological control agents?

answers.a: They eliminate all insect species in an ecosystem.
answers.b: They readily switch to alternative host species.
answers.c: They are usually highly host-specific and maintain pest populations at low densities.
answers.d: They increase the reproductive rate of pest insects.

questions.question: 4. During the simulation, increasing the searching efficiency (a) of the parasitoid is most likely to:

answers.a: Increase the probability that hosts escape parasitism.
answers.b: Reduce the number of hosts surviving to the next generation.
